# Code.org

> > Code.org is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit providing free K-12 computer science and artificial intelligence curriculum, teacher training, and advocacy to democratize CS education globally.

Code.org offers comprehensive CS and AI education resources aligned to CSTA standards, serving students, teachers, and advocates. The platform combines hands-on activities, professional development, and policy advocacy to expand equitable access to computer science education.

## Key Topics

- Computer Science Education
- Artificial Intelligence Literacy
- K-12 Curriculum
- Teacher Professional Development
- Hour of Code
- Hour of AI
- Generative AI
- AI Ethics
- CSTA Standards
- Machine Learning
- Free Curriculum
- Educational Advocacy
- CS Education Policy
- Inclusive Education
- Python Programming

## Core Platforms

- [Code.org Homepage](https://code.org): Main entry point offering free K-12 CS and AI curriculum with teacher professional development.
- [Students](https://code.org/students): Student learning platform with age-appropriate CS paths, projects, and career exploration.
- [Teach](https://code.org/teach): Teacher resource hub for free CS and AI curriculum aligned to CSTA, NGSS, and Common Core standards.
- [About Code.org](https://code.org/about): Code.org mission, impact metrics, and approach to expanding CS and AI education access.

## AI Education

- [Teach and Learn AI with Code.org](https://code.org/artificial-intelligence): Free AI lessons and activities covering How AI Works, machine learning, and generative AI.
- [Artificial Intelligence Foundations](https://code.org/curriculum/artificial-intelligence-foundations): High school AI curriculum with real-world applications, ethics, and hands-on learning.
- [AI Education Hub](https://code.org/ai): AI education resources including How AI Works, AI for Oceans, and Dance Party activities.
- [National AI Literacy Day](https://code.org/ai-literacy-day): National event with virtual workshops, activities, and teacher training for AI literacy.

## Teacher Professional Development

- [Professional Learning](https://code.org/professional-learning): Teacher training programs, workshops, and self-paced courses for CS educator development.
- [Incubator](https://code.org/incubator): Experimental features and pilot programs including AI Foundations and Python IDE.

## Advocacy & Impact

- [Promote Computer Science & AI in Schools](https://code.org/promote): CS advocacy page promoting equitable access to computer science in schools.
- [Code.org Advocacy Coalition](https://advocacy.code.org): Coalition of 100+ organizations advancing AI and CS education policy and resources.

## Support & Donations

- [Donate to Code.org](https://code.org/donate): Donation page supporting free curriculum, teacher training, and global CS education.
- [Campaign Donation](https://donate.code.org/campaign/686056/donate): Campaign donation page for Code.org's 501(c)(3) nonprofit CS education mission.

## Interactive Activities

- [Mix and Move with AI](https://code.org/mix-move-ai): Hands-on classroom activity combining dance, music generation, and AI learning.
